cms_nodes_link_fields_check.name: cms_nodes_link_fields_check
cms_nodes_link_fields_check.value: ("cms_nodes"."type" = 'link') = ("cms_nodes"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "cms_nodes"."open_mode" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: CASE WHEN paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'paid' WHEN captured_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'captured' ELSE 'authorized' END

payments_captured_check.name: payments_captured_check
payments_captured_check.value:
("payments"."captured_at" IS NULL) = ("payments"."captured_amount" IS NULL)
        AND ("payments"."captured_at" IS NULL OR (
          "payments"."captured_amount" > 0
          AND "payments"."captured_amount" <= "payments"."authorized_amount"
          AND "payments"."captured_at" >= "payments"."authorized_at"))

payments_paid_check.name: payments_paid_check
payments_paid_check.value:
"payments"."paid_at" IS NULL OR (
        "payments"."captured_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "payments"."paid_at" >= "payments"."captured_at")
